package.description: Customizable Windows terminal with tabs, splits, quake-style, hotkeys and more

en-US.description: Customizable Windows terminal with tabs, splits, quake-style, hotkeys and more
en-US.longDescription:
ConEmu-Maximus5 aims to be handy, comprehensive, fast and reliable terminal window where you may host any console application developed either for WinAPI (cmd, powershell, far) or Unix PTY (cygwin, msys, wsl bash).
As Windows console window enhancement (local terminal emulator), ConEmu presents multiple consoles and simple GUI applications (like PuTTY for example) as one customizable tabbed GUI window with various features.
Moreover, due to deep integration, ConEmu is the best companion for Far Manager, my favorite shell replacement.
ConEmu is an active project, open to suggestions.
en-US.name: ConEmu

zh-CN.description: 可自定义的 Windows 终端，支持标签、分屏、Quake 模式、热键等功能
zh-CN.longDescription:
ConEmu-Maximus5 致力于成为一款便捷、全面、快速且可靠的终端窗口，您可以在其中托管任何为 WinAPI（如 cmd、powershell、far）或 Unix PTY（如 cygwin、msys、wsl bash）开发的控制台应用程序。
作为 Windows 控制台窗口的增强工具（本地终端模拟器），ConEmu 将多个控制台和简单的 GUI 应用程序（例如 PuTTY）呈现为一个可自定义的标签式 GUI 窗口，具备多种功能。
此外，得益于深度集成，ConEmu 是我最喜爱的 Shell 替代品——Far Manager 的最佳搭档。
ConEmu 是一个活跃的项目，乐于接受建议。
